content: Hello, this is Alex Miller from the IRS Appeals Department. I'm calling regarding your federal tax account. Is this Mr. Kumar?
Yes, this is Kumar speaking. How can I help you?

Sir, we've noticed irregularities on your recent tax filings, and your Social Security Number has been temporarily suspended. This is a standard IRS protocol to prevent identity misuse. Are you aware of any suspicious activity on your account?
No, I have not received any notification before. What sort of irregularities?

Our system detected multiple filings under your SSN with conflicting income reports. This has triggered a federal review, and unfortunately a temporary hold on your tax status. If left unresolved, this could lead to further action.
I don't understand. What do I need to do to fix this?

Currently, your account is flagged for possible tax fraud, which is a serious offense. To avoid escalation, such as legal charges or a visit from local authorities, you must verify your identity and resolve the discrepancies immediately.
I really don't want any trouble. I am new to the country and don't know all these rules.
I understand, sir. That's why I'm here to help. The IRS is offering a one-time settlement to reinstate your Social Security Number and clear the tax issues, provided you act today.
What do I need to do for the settlement?
There is a reinstatement fee of $1,200, which must be paid through a secure method. This will immediately lift the suspension and close your case with the IRS.
How can I pay this fee? Can I use my bank account?
For expedited processing, the IRS requires payment through either Bitcoin or gift cards, such as Target or Walmart. This ensures proper tracking and immediate confirmation.
I have never used Bitcoin before. Can I just get the gift cards?
Absolutely, sir. Please visit a nearby store and purchase $1,200 in Target or Walmart gift cards. Once you have them, I'll instruct you on how to submit the codes for verification.
Okay, do I need to buy all in one card or split them?
You may split the amount between several cards if needed. Just make sure the total equals $1,200. Please do not share this with anyone at the store, as it is a confidential IRS process.
All right, I will go now and get the cards. What should I do after that?
Once you have the cards, return to the phone and read me the codes from the back of each card. This will allow us to process your reinstatement and provide you with a confirmation letter.
How long will it take to clear my record after I give you the codes?
It typically takes less than 15 minutes after we receive and verify your codes. You'll get an official IRS email confirming the resolution and lifting of your SSN suspension.
Okay, I will call back as soon as I have the cards.
